mainEntity.name: How is the transfer speed of this SSD?

acceptedAnswer.text:
out of the box with no performance optimization I am seeing:
Sequential Read - 12865 MB/s
Sequential Write - 13321 MB/s
Random Read - 1824707 IOPS
Random Write - 1509521 IOPS

I get these numbers from Samsung Magician

mainEntity.name: Can I use this SSD to improve my PC performance for tasks like video editing and 3D modelling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, this SSD is suitable for improving PC performance for tasks like video editing and 3D modeling due to its high sequential read and write speeds, random IOPS performance, and compatibility with both laptops and desktops.

review.description: Pros: Delivers good real world performance. Overall Review: Decided to quit penny pinching and put this in an ASUS Hyper M.2 x16 Gen 5 RAID card and it does rip. Do I need my editing software to load files this fast? No. Is it great that it does? Sure. I ran out of space and decided to give up on slow platter drives and just get a set of big SSDs. No, I'll never use only SSDs because the sheer amount of media is too much, but, having SSDs for "live files" is a nice luxury.
review.name: Big speed numbers!

review.description:
Overall Review: New  build ASUS ROG CROSSHAIR X870E EXTREME AMD X870E AM5 E-ATX , 2 SAMSUNG SSD 9100 PRO 4TB, PCIe 5.0x4 M.2 2280, 2 SAMSUNG 990 PRO 2TB SSD, PCIe Gen4 M.2 2280, G.SKILL Flare X5 256GB, ASUS PRIME GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16GB 256-Bit GDDR7 PCI Express 5.0 DLSS 4.0 Graphics Card, CORSAIR RMe Series RM1200e ATX Power Supply,  AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D,  ARCTIC ACFRE00180A Liquid Freezer III Pro 360 AIO CPU Cooler all inside a Corsair FRAME 4000D RS Black Steel / Tempered Glass ATX Mid Tower Computer Case- 3X CORSAIR RS Fans. Every thing was great for the first few days.  No cooling problems with any component .
After a few days had problems with one of the 9100 pros. So re-seated the unit and still problems. Now it will not even report in Seems to have fully failed after less then 2 weeks. The unit is in the M2.2 slot of the motherboard. This is the first time I have ever had a problem with Samsung. I am considering returning both 9100's and getting another set from some other vendor.
review.name: Samsung SSD's have been great.

review.description:
Pros: Shortened my boot time about 5 seconds. Rendered a 2.7gig video to 1.8gigs in 2 minutes,
with an Intel I5-12600kf. This is about a minute and a half faster then with my gen 4 ssd. Cons: I can not think of any cons at the moment, I have only used the drive for a few weeks. Overall Review: Really nice m2 ssd, gen 5 is not a great leap but a nice improvement in processing and snappy computing.
review.name: Very Fast M2.

review.description:
Pros: Was worried the heatsink would inpinge on the graphics card, and it was close!  Check your measurements carefully. As a happy accident it is now catching air off the graphics card exhaust hopefully its a net cooling but who knows. The heat spreader that came with the MB was useless so I'm glad I got something with a HS already attached.
sequential read only is even close to 14K, IOPS read though is 4.7 GB! really nice!  And you can tell the speed when installing software or moving data. Cons: None so far, been about a week now and its the least troublesome part of my new build. Overall Review: "If you have the means I highly recommend it." - Ferris Beuler.
review.name: So far so great!

review.description: Pros: Out of the box speeds are 14000 and over, using the magician software turn on boost its ever better. For the price and 5.0 you can't go wrong Cons: None Overall Review: Highly recommend
review.name: The best samsung ssd

review.description:
Pros: Samsung reliability 
Magician software 
Competes with the best Cons: You absolutely need a heatsink Overall Review: I built a new system and needed a new C drive with it so I decided to go with the the 9100 pro. I was originally planning on swapping both my 990 pros into this system but I decided to go with a new c drive and continue using my old system for other tasks. I don't notice much difference in speed between the two drives from day-to-day tasks, but data transfers and things like that are where you'll really see the difference.
review.name: Competes with the fastest drives on the market

review.description: Pros: Easy to install. Cons: Maybe its because I updated from an SSD with a 7kish read/write  that really seemed to be fast based on the SSD stick I upgraded from back then  but to jump up into the 14k range for both reading and writing with this stick, the difference in speed really seems unnoticeable to me. Overall Review: I would recommend purchasing with the heat sink. I didnt and ordered an aftermarket one. Shame on me. Otherwise, based on my experience, depending on what youre upgrading from will dictate whether you notice a worthwhile difference in speed. Nevertheless, a quality product.
